data_intervention: None. No labels/text/rows added, removed, rewritten, or reweighted. Preserve existing owner-attested snapshot and frozen memberships.
calibration_policy: No calibration or threshold tuning planned for operational use. Existing .65 is retained solely as a diagnostic comparison; raw predictions remain primary. Any calibration fit will be calibration-only, clearly diagnostic, and frozen before exposed test scoring.
intervention: One code-path intervention: scheduler advances only after a confirmed optimizer update; record attempted/successful/skipped steps, actual LR, first successful-step gradient coverage/norm, and exact before/selected per-layer parameter fingerprints.
optimizer: Adafactor with scale_parameter=False, relative_step=False, warmup_init=False and explicit LambdaLR warmup/decay
reserved_case_ids: Frozen manifests in prior report are authoritative; the 9 latest undertriage cases and 6 older list remain held out, union 9. No train movement.
test_policy: All current test, challenge, calibration, old-six/nine cases have historical model-development exposure. Fresh label will not be used. After validation selection and policy freeze, evaluate test only as EXPOSED_REGRESSION_DIAGNOSTIC; challenge is EXPOSED_CHALLENGE_DIAGNOSTIC.
hypothesis: The training loop currently steps the LR scheduler even when CUDA GradScaler skips an optimizer update. Fixing schedule/update accounting and recording AMP skips, finite nonzero gradient evidence, and per-layer selected-weight fingerprints improves training correctness and auditability; no causal claim is made about prior severity errors unless a skip is observed.
changes_from_previous: No architecture, labels, data, loss, tokenizer, optimizer, LR, schedule horizon, seed, split, or max_length change. Only AMP scheduler skip guard and evidence telemetry added.
training_inclusion: Only frozen TRAIN membership 514 rows; no old test/challenge/calibration row enters training. Original owner attestation is preserved without individual adjudication.
selection_rule: Existing balanced_safety order frozen: minimize raw Serious/Critical undertriage; then maximize fixed-four-label validation macro-F1; then maximize min(Critical recall, Serious recall); then Critical precision. Eligible only if validation meets all six existing research gates with same denominators; if none, status NO_ELIGIBLE_CHECKPOINT and retain diagnostic best by selection order only.
held_out: validation 126 for checkpoint selection; calibration 83 excluded from fit; exposed regression/test 84 excluded from fitting/selection; exposed challenge 43 excluded from fit/selection.
